Differences in claims within tolerance, summed over papers.  On the 3.2 set the total agent-over-pipeline-4.7 difference splits exactly into a model effect (pipeline on Opus 5.5 minus pipeline on 4.7) and a harness effect (agent minus pipeline on Opus 5.5).  The 3.4, 3.6, 3.7 and 3.9 papers have no 4.7 rows, so only the harness effect exists there.  One run per cell; no uncertainty is attached to any difference.
